markets.title: Stocks Slide After Weak Jobs Data as Bonds Climb: Markets Wrap
markets.description: Wall Street traders rushed out of riskier corners of the market, with stocks sliding amid a renewed wave of tech selling while bonds climbed after weak jobs data. Bitcoin briefly tumbled below $70,000. Silver plunged.

markets.title: Lagarde Plays Down Impact of Euro Rally as ECB Holds Rates
markets.description: The European Central Bank kept interest rates unchanged, with President Christine Lagarde downplaying the recent euro rally and again describing inflation as being in a “good place.”

markets.title: Gemini to Shutter UK, EU, Australia Customer Accounts
markets.description: Gemini Space Station Inc. said it plans to close all customer accounts in the UK, European Union and Australia.

markets.title: South Korea Launches $3 Billion Sale of Dollar Bonds
markets.description: South Korea is offering $3 billion of dollar bonds, in an effort to bolster its foreign exchange reserves amid global uncertainties and massive investments pledged under a US trade deal.

markets.title: Vanguard CEO Ramji Poaches From Goldman, BlackRock for Key Roles
markets.description: Vanguard Group Chief Executive Officer Salim Ramji is putting his imprint on the world’s second-largest asset manager by siphoning talent from Wall Street firms to fill key roles.

markets.title: Lagarde Says Stronger Euro Could Push Inflation Further Below Goal
US Jobless Claims Jump in Week Impacted by Severe Weather
markets.description: Applications for US unemployment benefits increased by 22,000 to 231,000 in the final week of January, rising by more than forecast. Michael McKee reports on Bloomberg Television. (Source: Bloomberg)

markets.title: Oil Declines After Iran Confirms US Negotiations Set for Friday
markets.description: Oil fell for the first time in three days after Iran confirmed it would hold negotiations with the US, easing the immediate risk of military strikes against the OPEC producer.

markets.title: New York’s Pension Funds Scrutinize Palantir Over ICE Contract
markets.description: New York’s pension funds are questioning Palantir Technologies Inc., a software company, over its business dealings with US Immigration and Customs Enforcement and the Department of Homeland Security.

markets.title: ECB Holds Rates at 2% as Tariffs Threaten Economy
markets.description: The European Central Bank kept interest rates unchanged at 2% as officials assess the economic toll of a rally in the euro and renewed trade unpredictability. Bloomberg's Lizzy Burden reports from Frankfurt. (Source: Bloomberg)

markets.title: Bitcoin Drops Below $70,000 as ‘Forced Deleveraging’ Accelerates
markets.description: Bitcoin tumbled below $70,000 Thursday as negative momentum deepened across cryptocurrencies, driven by vanishing marginal demand and this week’s volatility in tech equities along with precious metals.

markets.title: Tech Rout Deepens, Double Central Bank Decision Day | The Pulse 2/5/2026
markets.description: "The Pulse With Francine Lacqua" is all about conversations with high profile guests in the beating heart of global business, economics, finance and politics. Based in London, we go wherever the story is, bringing you exclusive interviews and market-moving scoops. Today's guests: Iain Stealey, JPMorgan Asset Management, Fixed Income International CIO; Bruna Skarica, Morgan Stanley, Chief UK Economist; Ellie Geranmayeh, European Council on Foreign Relations, Middle East and North Africa Program Deputy Director; Jackie Ineke, Spring Investments, CIO; Richard Harpin, HomeServe, Founder (Source: Bloomberg)

markets.title: Options Traders Pile Into Tech Hedges After Software Rout
markets.description: The unrelenting selloff in software shares has left tech investors antsy enough that they’re starting to pony up for protection against yet another steep slide.

markets.title: BOE's Bailey Sees Scope for Further Easing
markets.description: Bank of England Governor Andrew Bailey, speaking at a news conference in London, said there "should be scope for some further easing in monetary policy" given that inflation is on track to return to the 2% target "soon." Earlier the BOE voted 5-4 to leave rates unchanged at 3.75%. The closer-than-expected decision revived hopes of a move next month. (Source: Bloomberg)

markets.title: The David Rubenstein Show: Former US Vice President Mike Pence
markets.description: Former US Vice President Mike Pence looks back on the events of January 6 2021, his final days in office with President Trump and his vision for the future of the Republican Party. In a wide-ranging conversation with David Rubenstein, Pence also discusses Venezuela, the potential acquisition of Greenland and Fed independence. He appears on this week's episode of The David Rubenstein Show: Peer to Peer Conversations. This interview was recorded January 16 in Washington DC. (Source: Bloomberg)

markets.title: KKR’s Profit Hit by Clawback at Asia Private Equity Fund
markets.description: KKR & Co. reported a drop in fourth-quarter profit, missing Wall Street estimates, as asset sales declined and the firm took a charge for one of its private equity funds in Asia.

markets.title: Europe’s Reliance on US, Russian LNG Climbs to Record Above 80%
markets.description: Europe’s reliance on its two biggest providers of LNG surged to a record last month, stoking concern that the region is still failing to diversify.

markets.title: Silver Hit With Fresh Selloff in China After Tentative Recovery
markets.description: Silver fell sharply, at one point wiping out its two-day recovery, as the white metal struggled to find a floor following a historic market rout.

markets.title: Gilts Jump, Pound Drops as BOE Vote Fuels Bets on March Cut
markets.description: UK benchmark bonds reversed losses and the pound fell after Bank of England policymakers came unexpectedly close to cutting interest rates, prompting traders to bet on further monetary easing.

markets.title: US Companies Announce Most January Job Cuts Since 2009
markets.description: US companies announced 108,435 job cuts in January, a 118% increase from a year earlier, marking the largest number of job cuts for any January since the depths of the Great Recession in 2009, according to data from outplacement firm Challenger, Gray & Christmas Inc. Michael McKee reports on Bloomberg Television. (Source: Bloomberg)

technology.title: Peloton Slashes Sales Outlook, Misses Estimates Despite Hardware Debut
technology.description: Shares of Peloton Interactive Inc. tumbled by the most in more than two years after the company provided a weaker-than-expected revenue forecast for the fiscal third quarter, disappointing investors who hoped a recent hardware revamp would spur a long-promised turnaround.

technology.title: Liz Ann Sonders Explains Why the Broadening Trade Has Legs
technology.description: “Rotation is the new momentum trade,” says Liz Ann Sonders, chief investment strategist at Charles Schwab, as she sees the broadening out of markets as a “meaningful shift that probably will continue.” (Source: Bloomberg)

technology.title: Alphabet Plans Record Spending in Race to Win AI Customers
technology.description: Alphabet Inc. topped projections for quarterly revenue and outlined an ambitious capital spending plan, far surpassing predictions, leveraging its growth to build out the data centers and infrastructure needed to lead in the AI age.

technology.title: Inside the Numbers: David Vélez
technology.description: In Inside the Numbers, Nubank founder and CEO David Vélez unpacks the key figures behind the digital bank’s growth. (Source: Bloomberg)

technology.title: OpenAI Unveils Platform to Help Companies Deploy ‘AI Coworkers’
technology.description: OpenAI is introducing a new platform that’s designed to help companies deploy AI agents more easily, part of a broader push to cement itself as a leader in automating valuable work tasks.The new product, called Frontier, allows organizations to build and manage these AI tools so that each agent has appropriate guardrails and data access. The goal is to simplify the process of rolling out AI agents — or “AI coworkers,” as OpenAI calls them — and pave the way for broader adoption of the technology

technology.title: Nigeria Central Bank Moves to Rein In Fintech, Boost Access to Capital
technology.description: Nigeria is tightening scrutiny of its fast-growing fintech industry while easing licensing and improving access to capital as it tries to balance innovation with financial stability.

technology.title: Startup Goodfire Notches $1.25 Billion Valuation to Decode AI Models
technology.description: A growing cadre of multibillion-dollar startups are racing to create the best artificial intelligence models, able to absorb tasks from software engineers, musicians and paralegals. Eric Ho, the chief executive officer of a startup called Goodfire, thinks we’re moving too fast.

technology.title: Microsoft Gets Rare Downgrade as Stifel Warns on Azure Growth
technology.description: Microsoft Corp. was hit with a rare analyst downgrade, in the latest sign of how caution toward software companies is even spreading to some of the biggest and most influential names.

technology.title: Data Centers Power HVAC Growth as Residential Air Conditioning Sales Lag
technology.description: A data center boom, driven by increased AI usage, is emerging as a key growth driver for cooling, helping offset Carrier Global Corp.’s soft sales to residential customers and lifting Johnson Controls International Plc’s profit outlook to a decade high.

technology.title: Acharya: World is Still Short Software
technology.description: 'No one is vibe-coding their payroll' says Anish Acharya, General Partner at Andreessen Horowitz on this week's software sell off. 'I think the market has overreacted'. He joins Bloomberg's Guy Johnson, Anna Edwards and Tom Mackenzie on 'The Opening Trade'. (Source: Bloomberg)

technology.title: Hackers Hit Sensitive Targets in 37 Nations in Spying Plot
technology.description: An Asian cyber-espionage group has spent the past year breaking into computer systems belonging to governments and critical infrastructure organizations in more than 37 countries, according to the cybersecurity firm Palo Alto Networks, Inc.

technology.title: Anthropic’s New AI Legal Tool Triggered a Selloff Without Evidence
technology.description: Market reacted by selling first and asking questions after

technology.title: General Catalyst-Backed Startup Raises $75 Million to Bring AI to Accounting
technology.description: General Catalyst — the storied venture capital firm that’s undergoing a transformation into a broader and more ambitious financial company — is making its latest play to use AI to transform a legacy business: This time targeting accounting.

technology.title: Nubank CEO Bets $82 Billion Empire on Worldwide Expansion Plan
technology.description: David Velez’s favorite anecdote — the origin story of Latin America’s second-most valuable financial company — begins with a bulletproof door.

technology.title: Amazon Cloud Sales in Focus After Microsoft’s $500 Billion Rout
technology.description: All eyes will be Amazon.com Inc.’s cloud business when the technology giant reports earnings on Thursday, after shares of Microsoft Corp. plunged last week due in part to slowing growth at its key cloud-computing platform.

technology.title: How AI Answers Your Question May Depend on Your Politics

technology.title: Hackers Hit Sensitive Targets in 37 Nations in Vast Spying Plot

technology.title: Amazon Told to Drop Price Policy, Pay $70 Million in Germany
technology.description: Amazon.com Inc. must stop enforcing price controls for retailers on its German marketplace, according to the nation’s antitrust watchdog, which also seized €59 million ($70 million) from the Big Tech company. That amount is how much Amazon is estimated to have made via the illicit practice.

technology.title: Kyiv Says Russian Military Has Lost Access to Musk’s Starlink
technology.description: Starlink terminals used by Russian military units to provide satellite internet on the battlefield have been shut down, according to an adviser to Ukraine’s Defense Minister Mykhailo Fedorov.

technology.title: JPM Sees 'Opportunities' Coming Out of Tech Stocks Selloff
technology.description: JPMorgan Asset Management's Iain Stealey talks about the global slump in tech stocks, calling what happened in markets "AI jitters." He adds that the current environment is "great" for "good stock pickers" and there will be "a lot of opportunities coming out of this." Stealey speaks on Bloomberg Television. (Source: Bloomberg)

politics.title: Lagarde Says Inflation, ECB Policy in 'Good Place'
politics.description: "We are in a good place and inflation is in a good place," European Central Bank President Christine Lagarde told reporters in Frankfurt. She made the comments after the central bank decided to hold interest rates. (Source: Bloomberg)

politics.title: US Ambassador to Cut Contact With Polish Parliament Speaker
politics.description: US Ambassador to Poland Tom Rose said he’ll cease all contact with the speaker of the Polish Parliament Wlodzimierz Czarzasty due to his comments on President Donald Trump.

politics.title: Bailey Says He's 'Shocked' by Mandelson-Epstein Ties
politics.description: Bank of England Governor Andrew Bailey said he was “shocked” by Peter Mandelson’s ties with pedophile financier Jeffrey Epstein, adding that society must do some soul searching over the revelations. “How is it that we live in a society in which this happened while the cover-up happened as well,” Bailey said during a monetary policy press conference. (Source: Bloomberg)

politics.title: Lagarde: Stronger Euro Could Push Inflation Lower
politics.description: European Central Bank President Christine Lagarde tells reporters in Frankfurt that a stronger euro could "bring inflation down beyond current expectations." She speaks to reporters in Frankfurt following the ECB's decision to keep interest rates unchanged. (Source: Bloomberg)

politics.description: The Chinese readout of the Xi-Trump call makes no mention of a planned April meeting.
